premises.text: Attempts to fly near obstacles are crashing; drones lack the eyes and brain for that airspace
premises.evidence_span: Some companies are even trying to fly in this airspace now, and they are crashing everywhere.

premises.text: Guardian automatically detects and avoids obstacles as the first commercially available system of its kind
premises.evidence_span: automatically detects obstacles in the environment and avoids them

premises.text: Adjustable safety distance and interchangeable sensors adapt the system to varied lighting and environments
premises.evidence_span: The safety distance of the drone is adjustable and the sensors on board can be changed for a variety of lighting conditions and environments.

premises.text: Inspection-industry partnerships, starting with a major wind-turbine maintenance firm, are the route to market
premises.evidence_span: We've already partnered with our first early adopter, Upwind Solutions.

premises.text: A 90-day early-adopter program with 20 customers co-develops the roadmap from on-site feedback
premises.evidence_span: inviting 20 customers to work with us for 90 days

premises.text: An NSF SBIR extension adds avoidance of other aircraft in shared airspace
premises.evidence_span: working closely with the National Science Foundation through a phase one SBIR to extend our capabilities

value.text: Companies unlock their aerial workforce as drones work safely around obstacles
value.evidence_span: finally enable companies to unlock their aerial workforce

causal_links.evidence_span: So not only will it avoid obstacles near it, it will also avoid other aircraft in the airspace
will finally allow people that are not highly trained pilots to use drones
inspecting over 10,000 wind turbines a year using our system

notes: Finer reading: configurability (safety distance, sensor swaps) is split from the core avoidance capability because it conditions deployment across environments, and the early-adopter program is split from the partnership channel as a distinct co-development mechanism. The extension dependency is coded from the 'not only ... also' construction, which presents aircraft avoidance as building on the obstacle-avoidance base; direction noted as additive-leaning. Market-size forecasts and team pedigree excluded.
